name: Exp_DiNapoliStochastic
summary: This EA trades based on the DiNapoli Stochastic indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below. It supports configurable money management modes, stop loss/take profit, and independent toggle switches for opening and closing positions on both sides. Trades are executed only on new bars to avoid redundant signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于DiNapoli随机指标进行交易，当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。支持可配置的资金管理模式、止损止盈，以及多空两侧开仓和平仓的独立开关。仅在新增K线时执行交易以避免重复信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用DiNapoli随机指标作为核心交易信号源，属于动量交叉策略。入场条件：当指标线(%K)上穿信号线(%D)时产生买入信号，当指标线下穿信号线时产生卖出信号，具体通过比较相邻两根K线的指标值与信号值来判定交叉。出场条件：多头持仓在指标线下穿信号线时平仓，空头持仓在指标线上穿信号线时平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制仓位大小比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式。EA使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复开仓，同时通过BarsCalculated检查指标数据是否就绪。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the DiNapoli Stochastic indicator as its core trading signal source, implementing a momentum crossover strategy. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator line crosses above the signal line, and a sell signal is generated when it crosses below, determined by comparing indicator and signal values across two consecutive bars. Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator line crosses below the signal line, and short positions are closed on the opposite crossover, with fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for sizing ratio and the MMMode parameter for the calculation method. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trade entries, and verifies indicator data readiness via BarsCalculated before processing.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management: controls lot size or ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Money management mode: fixed lot, balance ratio, equity ratio, etc.

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号判断的K线索引

pros: 具有独立的买卖开仓和平仓开关，灵活控制交易方向
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
支持五种仓位管理模式，适应不同风险偏好
设有止损和止盈，具备基本风险控制
使用自定义DiNapoli随机指标，相比传统随机指标减少了市场噪音
pros_en: Independent toggle switches for buy/sell opening and closing provide flexible directional control
New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades within the same bar
Five position sizing modes accommodate different risk preferences
Stop loss and take profit settings provide basic risk control
DiNapoli Stochastic reduces market noise compared to traditional stochastic oscillators
cons: 缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
依赖外部指标文件DiNapoliStochastic，缺少内嵌容错处理
代码中大量注释为乱码（编码问题），影响可读性和维护性
cons_en: No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills during high-spread conditions
No position check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without ATR-based dynamic adaptation to volatility
Depends on external indicator file DiNapoliStochastic without embedded fallback handling
Garbled comments due to encoding issues severely impact readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
加入点差过滤和ATR动态止损止盈机制，提升适应性
improvements_en: Add position existence checks to prevent duplicate same-direction entries
Implement spread filtering and ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit for better adaptability

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查，可能导致同方向重复开仓放大风险
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在极端行情下可能不足
risk_points_en: Missing position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries amplifying risk
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to volatility changes, potentially insufficient during extreme market conditions

Trades are executed only on new bars to avoid redundant signals.
